name: 5paisa Capital Ltd
title: 5paisa Capital Ltd - 540776 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Broking-platform read: F&O premium up 22% QoQ to INR 1,336 crore and client funding book up 8% to INR 410 crore, but PAT fell to INR 44.3 crore on tech and HR spend and no capacity signal is given.

triggers.quote: in Q4, our F & O premium growth grew to INR 1,336 crores, which is an increase of 22% QoQ

summary.headline: 5paisa Q4 FY26 total revenue rose 8% QoQ to INR 85.5 crore, with PAT of INR 44.3 crore and a INR 468 crore rights issue completed.
summary.overview: Management described a volatile quarter driven by the Iran war, Brent above USD 100/bbl, rupee weakness and AI-related valuation pressure, with indices down about 11%. Customer acquisition rose 33% QoQ to over one lakh in Q4, taking the total base to 51.8 lakh. Broking revenue grew 13% QoQ to INR 41.8 crore and aligned income rose 5% to INR 20.7 crore. Profit fell slightly YoY (per the CFO) due to tech and HR investment, and the rights issue lifted net worth above INR 1,100 crore.

financial_highlights.change: Profit slightly declined YoY per CFO; QoQ not stated

financial_highlights.metric: Average client funding book (T+5 margin + MTF)

segments.name: Broking
segments.commentary: Broking revenue INR 41.8 crore, up 13% QoQ; F&O premium INR 1,336 crore, up 22% QoQ. Market share about 2% in both F&O and cash.

segments.name: Lending (MTF / margin funding)
segments.commentary: Average client funding book INR 410 crore, up 8% QoQ. Eligible MTF stock universe expanded from 700 to 1,500+ stocks; investor limit raised to INR 3 crore.

segments.name: Mutual funds / investing
segments.commentary: MF AUM INR 1,761 crore, down 6% QoQ, partly due to mark-to-market on falling markets. Stock SIPs reintroduced and ETF dashboard launched.

guidance_outlook: Rights issue proceeds to go to three areas: funding higher trading volumes and client margins/exchange requirements, growing the MTF book, and core business expansion via marketing, brand, product, tech and AI.
Margin funding capacity already increased to 1.5x of existing capacity, per the prospectus-stated use of funds.
No explicit numeric guidance on revenue, margins or customer targets was given.
capex_capacity: Rights issue raised INR 468 crore; capital to be deployed into margin capacity, MTF growth and core business expansion.
Margin capacity increased to 1.5x of existing capacity, per the CFO.
Latency reduced for order placement, caching of static data and smaller API payloads introduced; charting load times improved.
Hiring in product & tech, marketing and AI teams drove higher employee costs.
demand_pricing: Exchange retail F&O premium ADTO grew 22% QoQ to INR 78,000 crore; exchange retail cash ADTO grew 10% QoQ to INR 43,974 crore.
Demat account additions slowed to about 8.5 million in the quarter, down about 3% QoQ.
Q4 acquisition up 33% QoQ to over one lakh customers; CTR (cost-to-revenue) and first-year revenue per customer improved, per management.
Other expenses rose on higher customer acquisition spend versus Q3.

qa_highlights.question: How is the rights issue money being utilised, and has any been deployed yet?
qa_highlights.answer: Deployment is planned in three areas: supporting higher trading volumes and client margins, growing the MTF book, and core business expansion. The CFO said margin capacity has already been raised to 1.5x of existing capacity, per the prospectus.

qa_highlights.question: What was the outcome of the earlier-discussed corporate action, and what is the customer acquisition strategy?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said revenue rose 8%, while profit declined slightly due to tech and HR investment, with no unusual items beyond what was published. Strategy targets pro traders with trading-stack depth and long-term investors with MF, ETFs and MTF.

qa_highlights.question: What is the market share?
qa_highlights.answer: Approximately 2% in both F&O and cash segments.

risks_watch: Profit declined slightly YoY on tech and HR spend; watch whether PAT recovers as acquisition costs and hiring normalise.
Market-linked revenue and MF AUM are exposed to volatility (geopolitics, crude above USD 100/bbl, rupee weakness, AI-led valuation swings).
Retail participation moderated (demat additions down 3% QoQ); sustaining customer growth at Q4 pace is unproven.
Deployment of INR 468 crore rights proceeds and resulting margin-book growth need tracking against exchange capital requirements.
Management did not give numeric guidance; the call was short (about 15 minutes) with only two analyst questions.
summary.management_tone: Confident on growth metrics such as acquisition, F&O premium and MTF expansion, but candid that markets were volatile. Answers on the prior corporate outcome and acquisition strategy were brief and general, with no hard targets.
key_quotes: So we acquired 33% more customers as compared to the quarter before that.
Our total customer base reached 51.8 lakh, and in Q4, our F & O premium growth grew to INR 1,336 crores, which is an increase of 22% QoQ.
So, we successfully completed our rights issue, which was oversubscribed, and amount of money raised was INR 468 crores.

adds.what: Margin funding capacity increased to 1.5x of existing capacity (funded via rights issue proceeds)

growth.why: No numeric revenue or margin guidance was given; management said margin funding capacity is already 1.5x and rights issue proceeds (INR 468 crore) fund margin capacity, MTF growth and core expansion, but no timelines or volumes were specified.
